name: Itsuka Ochiru Kono Koku de
original_name: いつか落ちるこの刻で
source:
If you could stop time for three minutes, what would you do?

Isa Hirakase, the self-proclaimed "fairy of time", had given me privilege to use the "time-stopping hourglass". What would I do with such a thing?

...This is the story of a week that she and I spent together.
The beginning of the long and short time spent with a girl who can stop time.

[translated from [url=http://daydream2011.web.fc2.com/ituochi/story.html]official website[/url]]
